seo_root_description: Upload an EPUB or PDF, let Foreword rank the vocabulary you actually need, and study it before you read. The book never leaves your browser.
privacy_policy_seo_description: Privacy policy placeholder for the application template.
privacy_policy_subtitle: How Foreword handles your books and your data.
privacy_policy_intro: Foreword is built so that the books you upload never leave your device. This page explains what is stored and why.
privacy_policy_information_we_collect_bo: We store your account (name, email, sessions) and, per book, its title, author, language, a fingerprint of the file, ranked words with short example snippets, the study cards generated from them, and your study history. We never store the uploaded file or the full text of the book.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_information_bo: Ranked words and snippets are sent to an AI provider only to write translations, explanations and examples. Study history is used to compute your progress and prioritise cards.
privacy_policy_service_providers_body: Hosting and database, Google Sign-In, Google Gemini for card text, and fal.ai for optional teaching clips.
privacy_policy_your_choices_body: You can edit or delete any card, export a book's vocabulary as CSV, and delete a book together with everything stored for it.
privacy_policy_contact_body: Replace this contact address with the support or privacy inbox for your project.
accessibility_statement_seo_description: Accessibility statement placeholder for the application template.
accessibility_statement_subtitle: Foreword aims to be usable by everyone, in both English and Hebrew.
accessibility_statement_intro: The interface is built with accessible primitives, keyboard navigation, visible focus states and full right-to-left layouts.
accessibility_statement_commitment_body: Describe your commitment to inclusive access and the standard your product aims to meet.
accessibility_statement_adjustments_body: List the concrete adjustments in your app, such as semantic structure, keyboard support, readable contrast, and responsive layouts.
accessibility_statement_limitations_body: Document known accessibility gaps and the plan for addressing them.
accessibility_statement_contact_body: Replace this contact address with the inbox that should receive accessibility feedback.

seo_root_title: Learn the words before you open the book
footer_tagline: Vocabulary prepared before the first page.
hero_badge: Private by design: your book stays on your device
hero_subtitle: Foreword reads your EPUB or PDF in the browser, ranks the vocabulary you are most likely to stumble on, and turns it into study cards with translations, explanations, and real sentences from the book.
preview_footer: Ranked by difficulty, frequency, and how soon each word appears.
workflow_title: From a file on your laptop to a study session in minutes.
workflow_description: Three steps. The heavy lifting happens in your browser, so even a 600-page novel is ready before your coffee cools.
workflow_upload_description: Drop in an EPUB or a text-based PDF. Foreword extracts chapters, metadata and language locally and fingerprints the file so you never import the same book twice.
workflow_prepare_description: Words and phrases are ranked by difficulty for your level, frequency in the book, how early they appear, and usefulness. Only the shortlist plus short snippets reach the AI, which writes the cards.
workflow_study_description: Flip flashcards, answer multiple-choice questions, or recall translations from memory. Every answer updates the card's state, so the queue shrinks as you learn.
features_title: Everything you need to read with confidence.
features_description: Foreword is opinionated about one thing: you should spend your time reading, not looking words up.
feature_private_title: Your book never leaves the device
feature_private_description: Parsing, ranking and hashing happen in a Web Worker. The server only stores ranked words, short snippets and your progress.
feature_ranking_title: Smart ranking, not a dictionary dump
feature_ranking_description: Difficulty for your level, in-book frequency, earliness, story importance, and phrases and idioms all feed a single priority score.
feature_modes_description: Flashcards for a first pass, multiple choice for recognition, recall for real mastery. Cards graduate to Known as you prove you know them.
feature_video_title: A short scene for hard words
feature_video_description: Stuck on an abstract word? Generate a five-second clip that shows its meaning, powered by fal.ai and TanStack AI.
feature_rtl_description: The interface, the cards and the layout switch direction properly. Book text and translations each render in their own direction.
feature_export_description: Export any book's vocabulary as CSV for Anki, spreadsheets or printing.
